stdout:
usage: clean.py [-h] [--repo REPO] [--include INCLUDE]
                [--older-than OLDER_THAN] [--apply] [--plan sha256:DIGEST]
                [--prune-merged] [--branch NAME | --merged-since REV] [--json]

Classify Provenant run artifacts and remove only an approved, unchanged plan.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO
  --include INCLUDE
  --older-than OLDER_THAN
  --apply
  --plan sha256:DIGEST  digest of a saved plan; with --apply, delete its rows
                        that are still eligible
  --prune-merged        remove clean ancestry-proven merged worktrees
  --branch NAME
  --merged-since REV
  --json
